Background Remover is an image background removal API. Upload a photo or send its URL and it returns a PNG with the background made transparent, or replaced with a solid color you choose.

Birth Chart calculates a tropical natal chart from a birth date, time and location. It returns the sun, moon and rising signs, the ascendant and midheaven, and each planet's sign, degree and retrograde flag. Paid plans add the 12 house cusps, each planet's house, the major aspects and the element a…

Cash Flow Statement returns operating, investing and financing cash flows for a US public company by ticker - straight from SEC filings, with free cash flow, FCF margin and cash-conversion metrics calculated for you.

Dividends returns the dividend-per-share history for a US public company by ticker - the amount reported each quarter and year straight from official SEC filings - plus a derived dividend-growth summary with year-over-year growth, multi-year growth rates and a consecutive-years-of-growth streak cal…

Domain Age returns when a domain was first registered and how old it is in days, months and years, with a readable age, an age bracket and a newly-registered flag. Paid plans add the expiration date and the last registry update.

Financial Ratios returns the key profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency and cash-flow ratios for a US public company by ticker - margins, ROE, ROA, current ratio, debt-to-equity, interest coverage, asset turnover, FCF margin and more - all computed from SEC filing data.

Gas Prices returns average retail gasoline, diesel and LPG prices from official weekly government surveys for the US, the UK, all 27 EU countries and the EU average. Pass a country, or a US state, region or city, to get the latest week with week-over-week and year-over-year changes, in any currency…

IBAN Validator checks an IBAN's mod-97 checksum, its length and format for the country, and national check digits where the country defines them. It returns whether the IBAN is valid, the country and the reasons it fails. Paid plans add the bank code, branch code and account number, the correct che…

Income Statement returns the profit and loss statement for a US public company by ticker - revenue, cost of revenue, gross profit, operating income and net income - straight from SEC filings, with gross, operating and net margins and year-over-year growth calculated for you.

Insider Trading returns recent SEC Form 4 insider transactions for a US public company by ticker - who bought or sold, their role, the number of shares, price and transaction type - plus a derived insider-sentiment summary with net buy/sell activity and cluster-buy detection calculated for you.

Office to PDF converts Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, text and CSV files to PDF and returns a download link valid for 2 days, with the page count of the result. Upload the file or send its URL. Paid plans can convert only selected pages and set landscape orientation.

Nutrition returns the nutrition facts for a generic whole food by name - calories and the core macronutrients per 100 grams straight from the USDA food composition database - plus, on paid plans, a full micronutrient panel and derived nutrition intelligence like calories per gram and the protein, f…

Palladium Price tracks real-time spot rates for palladium per ounce, gram, and kilogram in USD. It supplies 24-hour price changes and update timestamps, while paid plans add custom currencies and 24-hour hourly history.

Password Breach Checker tells you whether a password appears in the Pwned Passwords corpus of passwords exposed in data breaches. Send the password or its SHA-1 hash and get a breached flag. Paid plans add how many times it was seen and a risk level.

PDF Page Numbers stamps a page number on every page of a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, and returns a download link to the numbered file. Choose the corner or edge and the font size. Paid plans can also set a label format such as Page 3 of 12, the starting number, and skip a cover page.

PDF to Text extracts the text layer of a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, and returns it as plain text with the page, word and character counts. Paid plans add the text of each page separately and the document metadata, such as title, author and creation date.

PDF to Image renders the pages you choose from a PDF, uploaded or fetched from a URL, as PNG or JPG images and returns a download link for each, valid for 2 days, with its pixel size. The Free plan renders one page per call at 150 dpi; paid plans render up to 10 pages per call and can set the resol…

Platinum Price retrieves real-time spot rates for platinum per troy ounce, gram, and kilogram. Each response reports prices in USD, 24-hour net price changes, direction markers, and update timestamps, with paid plans supporting 172 currencies.

PDF Merge combines 2 to 10 PDFs into one file, keeping their order, and returns a download link valid for 2 days. Upload the files or send their URLs. Paid plans add a breakdown of where each source document starts and ends in the merged file.

Sanctions Screening checks a person or company name against the US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. It returns scored matches with aliases, dates of birth, addresses and sanctions programs so you can decide whether to block or review.

SEC Filings returns the recent EDGAR filing history for a US public company by ticker - 10-K annual reports, 10-Q quarterlies, 8-K current reports, Form 4 insider filings, S-1 registrations and more - each with its filing date, form type and a direct link to the document, plus derived filing-activi…

Website Tech Stack Detector identifies the technologies a website runs on, such as its CMS, ecommerce platform, JavaScript framework, analytics, CDN and hosting, with categories and a confidence score for each. Paid plans add detected versions, CPE identifiers and a rendered mode that runs the page…

Visa Requirements tells you what a passport holder needs to enter another country: no visa, an electronic travel authorization, an eVisa, a visa on arrival, a visa arranged in advance, or entry restricted. It also returns the allowed stay in days where one is set. Paid plans can list every destinat…

Weather Alerts returns the severe weather warnings, watches and advisories in effect right now for any point or state in the United States, straight from the National Weather Service. Each alert names the event, how severe and urgent it is, the area covered, when it starts and ends, and what to do.

Pure OpenAPI spec parsing and HTTP execution library. Zero dependencies on HPD-Agent or Microsoft.Extensions.AI.
